value: Instruction-following, reasoning, and coding tasks (including agentic coding and function calling) in a single unified model, with text and image input.

and coding in a single set of weights. [...] Reasoning effort is configurable per request, so the same model can answer a quick chat reply or work through a complex agentic run. [...] Use `reasoning_effort="high"` for complex tasks and agentic coding.

It is a dense 128B model with a 256k context window, handling instruction-following, reasoning,
and coding in a single set of weights.
Reasoning effort is configurable per request, so the same model can answer a quick chat reply or work through a complex agentic run.
Use `reasoning_effort="high"` for complex tasks and agentic coding.

value: The card has no dedicated limitations section. It warns that an incorrect Transformers config entry caused long-context performance degradation, which also affects GGUFs generated from the pre-fix config. It also says frameworks that rely on the Transformers config will show subpar performance, especially in long-context sessions, unless they include the fix.
quote: The Transformers config originally had an incorrect entry that caused long-context performance degradation. [...] GGUFs generated using the Transformers config prior to this commit are also affected. [...] Otherwise, you will experience subpar performance, especially in long-context sessions.
quotes: The Transformers config originally had an incorrect entry that caused long-context performance degradation.
